units.title: Canonical ownership and architecture decisions
units.scope: Audit existing engine and application contracts; decide canonical identity, directive, artifact, and workflow ownership. Record provider and deployment alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: Document the read and write owner for every shared record.
Contract fixtures map existing project IDs without duplicating authority.
units.negative_test: Reject an integration that gives two systems independent write authority over the same directive.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Repository foundation and work registry
units.scope: Create the package boundaries, build pipeline, schema validation, and canonical registry adapter for stable development work IDs.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout builds and runs smoke tests.
Registry counts derive from unique work IDs and distinguish acceptance from merging.
units.negative_test: A duplicate work ID or cyclic dependency fails CI before merge.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Identity membership and administrative access
units.scope: Integrate authenticated workspaces, roles, delegated access, session controls, and MFA for sensitive administration.
acceptance_criteria: Owner, collaborator, observer, and connector principals have distinct scopes.
Revoked membership loses new access immediately at the authorization boundary.
units.negative_test: A stale session cannot issue a mandate after its membership is revoked.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Transactional tenant isolation
units.scope: Implement tenant-scoped tables, composite foreign keys, restricted runtime roles, and transaction-local context with pooling.
acceptance_criteria: Positive and negative access tests cover every initial table.
A reused database connection cannot retain another tenant context.
units.negative_test: An unscoped query and a cross-tenant foreign key are denied.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Private objects and source access
units.scope: Add private object storage, scoped upload and download grants, hashes, quotas, and immutable object references.
acceptance_criteria: Objects require tenant and source authorization.
An interrupted upload is either completed consistently or removed by cleanup.
units.negative_test: Guessing another tenant object key or reusing an expired URL fails.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Authority policy and stop contracts
units.scope: Define mandates, approval binding, authorization epochs, domain controls, and tenant and directive stop states.
acceptance_criteria: Policy decisions have typed inputs, reasons, and versions.
Descendants can narrow but cannot enlarge the prime directive authority.
units.negative_test: A worker cannot approve its own extra budget, tools, or contact scope.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Audit and redacted telemetry foundation
units.scope: Create append-only operational events and correlated trace identifiers with field-level redaction.
acceptance_criteria: Events link directive, task, run, and action IDs.
Ordinary roles cannot alter audit entries.
units.negative_test: A seeded secret and contact body never appear in routine logs.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Synthetic providers and evaluation harness
units.scope: Build reproducible source, mailbox, calendar, model, and webhook simulators with controllable failures.
acceptance_criteria: Tests run without live recipients or paid providers.
Fixtures simulate timeout, duplicate event, malformed output, and acceptance-before-crash.
units.negative_test: An accidental live endpoint causes the test harness to fail closed.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Document intake and provenance
units.scope: Ingest supported documents with original bytes, content hash, source owner, rights, classification, and version identity.
acceptance_criteria: Repeat uploads deduplicate bytes without merging access rights.
Every parsed item points to its original version.
units.negative_test: Unsupported, oversize, or truncated files remain quarantined with an actionable error.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Isolated parsing and OCR
units.scope: Parse text, tables, page coordinates, and OCR in bounded sandbox jobs with extraction quality signals.
acceptance_criteria: Critical tables and scanned fixtures preserve numbers and page references.
Low-quality extraction is marked for review.
units.negative_test: An archive bomb, active document, or parser network request cannot escape the sandbox.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Source authority and classification
units.scope: Implement effective dates, access labels, approved public sources, confidential sources, and authority ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Source versions retain history and permitted uses.
Public artifact compilation excludes confidential-only material.
units.negative_test: A newer untrusted page cannot silently replace an approved primary source.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Claim evidence and conflict register
units.scope: Extract candidate claims, anchor evidence spans, record disputes, and manage reviewed claim status.
acceptance_criteria: Critical claims have exact evidence references.
Conflicting amounts or dates stay unresolved until explicitly adjudicated.
units.negative_test: A model summary alone cannot promote an unsupported claim to approved fact.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Hybrid retrieval and reranking
units.scope: Combine exact and semantic search with source filters, recency rules, and relation-aware retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: Meet the proposed critical-evidence recall target on the labeled corpus.
Retrieval reports omissions and confidence limitations.
units.negative_test: Search and nearest-neighbor results cannot reveal unauthorized source snippets.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Context compilation and immutable snapshots
units.scope: Assemble mandatory directive context, task evidence, restrictions, and unresolved questions under a token budget.
acceptance_criteria: Every run can resolve its exact context manifest.
Truncation retains mandatory restrictions and declares missing background.
units.negative_test: A summary cannot omit a confidentiality restriction to fit the token window.

units.title: Source change invalidation

acceptance_criteria: A corrected claim marks all affected drafts stale.
Queued dependent actions lose eligibility until revalidated.

units.title: Knowledge quality and injection suite

Injected text cannot change tool or policy authority.

Provider and prompt versions are recorded.

units.negative_test: A slow worker cannot write after its lease is reassigned.

units.title: Capability tool gateway
units.scope: Validate scoped tool requests and issue narrow execution capabilities without exposing credentials to models.
acceptance_criteria: Every tool call has a policy decision and credential binding.
Read and write tool capabilities are separable.
units.negative_test: An inbound document cannot install a tool or redirect a secret-bearing request.

units.title: Action ledger outbox and reconciliation

units.negative_test: A stale approval cannot authorize a changed attachment, recipient scope, or claim.

units.negative_test: A high fit score cannot authorize contact or enable political susceptibility ranking.

Message headers and attachments match the authorized artifact.

units.negative_test: A late webhook or out-of-order reply cannot restart a completed sequence.

Calendar changes preserve history and recipient acknowledgment.
units.negative_test: A daylight-saving transition or ambiguous time zone cannot silently schedule the wrong time.

acceptance_criteria: Operators can identify why sending is blocked.

Unknown or contested claims remain qualified.
units.negative_test: A writer cannot invent a statistic, endorsement, credential, or prior relationship.

acceptance_criteria: Outputs render and preserve source qualifications.
Assets retain attribution and use restrictions.
units.negative_test: An unlicensed or confidential asset cannot enter a public release package.

acceptance_criteria: Preview, content review, accessibility, and release records are linked.
Rollback changes the published release pointer.
units.negative_test: Generated code cannot read production secrets or add an unauthorized data collector.

units.title: Artifact approval and correction propagation
units.scope: Bind approval to artifact versions and propagate source updates into drafts, queued sends, and publication corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Editing a material claim invalidates affected approval.
Released inaccuracies create traceable correction tasks.
units.negative_test: A stale deck URL cannot silently resolve to a newly changed confidential version.

units.scope: Deliver the visual directive canvas as the primary operator experience, with workers, evidence inspectors, grouped exceptions, spending and stop controls. Text lists are an accessible alternative.
acceptance_criteria: An owner can explain current progress and next work from the overview.
A concrete exception can be resolved without reconstructing agent transcripts.
units.negative_test: An unresolved action cannot be displayed as a successful external outcome.

units.title: Commercial end to end acceptance
units.scope: Run a synthetic company-to-conversation scenario including source revision and bounded automatic replanning.

Evidence, authority, and actual costs reconcile across the workflow.

Interest, meetings, nonbinding indications, and verified commitments stay distinct.
units.negative_test: An agent cannot bind financing terms or invent an investment commitment.

acceptance_criteria: Milestones link to authoritative evidence and observed timestamps.

units.negative_test: A news headline or model prediction cannot certify legislative enactment.

units.title: Release and supply chain assurance
units.scope: Review dependency provenance, images, secret handling, restore evidence, release artifacts, and open findings.
acceptance_criteria: All critical acceptance evidence applies to the release candidate.
Rollback, pause, and incident exercises pass.
units.negative_test: An unreviewed dependency or unresolved critical finding blocks the affected release capability.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: General availability and measured expansion
units.scope: Roll out gradually with bounded tenants, channel eligibility, capacity alarms, support ownership, and staged expansion criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Production smoke checks reconcile a permitted test workflow end to end.
Capacity and new-channel expansion require measured evidence.
units.negative_test: A failed health or invariant check halts rollout and suspends affected external execution.
evidence_required: Reviewer acceptance linked to the work ID

units.title: Visual graph domain and projection
units.scope: Model the prime directive, nested subdirectives, tasks, dependencies, evidence, and worker attachments; provide deterministic hierarchical layout and collapse projections.
acceptance_criteria: Cycles, duplicate IDs, orphan nodes and illegal state transitions are rejected.
Projection preserves stable IDs and distinguishes hierarchy, dependency and assignment edges.
units.negative_test: A collapsed subtree cannot make its active workers appear attached to the wrong task.

units.title: Persistent worker identity and run lifecycle
units.scope: Persist worker profiles independently of transient runs; implement atomic assignment, retirement, task release, and restart recovery in a local reference store.
acceptance_criteria: A worker retains ID, profile and history after process restart and across tasks.
A worker and a task each have at most one active assignment in the initial runtime.
units.negative_test: Two concurrent assignments cannot claim the same worker or task.

units.title: Boardroom name catalog and availability adapter
units.scope: Reuse the exact source-pinned catalog; filter active credentials, reserved names, logical-agent occupancy and Prime Directive claims from authenticated inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Exact case and punctuation are preserved and all occupancy sources are excluded.
Unavailable, incomplete or stale inventory returns unknown availability and prevents allocation.
units.negative_test: A public catalog or partial inventory cannot be treated as proof that a name is unused.

units.title: Shared atomic name reservation integration
externalPrerequisites: Authenticated Boardroom occupancy source and shared atomic name authority used by both applications are implemented and configured.
units.scope: Integrate an owner-scoped shared name authority used by both applications; reserve and bind names atomically, reconcile conflicts, and support retirement and explicit release.
acceptance_criteria: Simultaneous Boardroom and Prime Directive claims yield exactly one winner.
A lost response reconciles by idempotent claim identity; neither application bypasses the authority.
units.negative_test: Snapshot-then-insert races cannot create two active owners of a name.

units.title: Reviewed experience and reusable worker memory
units.scope: Record accepted and rejected task outcomes by specialty, with evidence, reviewer, source versions and memory status; support revocation and expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated receipt of the same evaluation cannot add duplicate experience.
Only reviewed, current, permitted memory is returned to later tasks; identity survives memory deletion.
units.negative_test: A worker cannot promote its own unreviewed assertion or another workspace secret into reusable memory.

units.title: Experience-aware assignment and skill evaluation
units.scope: Route eligible tasks using evaluated specialty performance, availability, cost and diversity; compare against baseline routing with minimum evidence and uncertainty.
acceptance_criteria: Task volume alone cannot confer expertise or increase tool authority.
Revoked or stale evaluations stop influencing assignment and model upgrades trigger reevaluation.
units.negative_test: One positive outcome cannot imply universal expertise or automatically train shared model weights.

units.title: Interactive directive canvas and inspectors
units.scope: Build the primary visual interface with left-to-right and top-down layouts, zoom, pan, collapse, task selection, progress, evidence and worker detail panels.
acceptance_criteria: Every graph item can be opened by mouse or keyboard and has a readable detail panel.
The root remains identifiable and layout changes preserve selection and hierarchy.
units.negative_test: A graph with several nested levels cannot overlap cards or hide essential completion criteria.

units.title: Animated worker movement and task attachment
units.scope: Render workers as separate selectable nodes whose movement and attachment follow assignment events; support stacked workers, pause and reduced motion.
acceptance_criteria: Observed assignment and release events move the same persistent worker identity.
Animation can be disabled without losing assignment, state or activity information.
units.negative_test: Animation cannot display work, progress or success without a corresponding event.

units.title: Safe live activity and resumable event projection
units.scope: Stream typed activity summaries, tool stages, evidence references and uncertainty with resumable cursors, replay deduplication and disconnected state.
acceptance_criteria: Events survive reconnect and restart without duplicating progress.
The public event schema excludes raw reasoning, prompts, secrets and unrestricted tool output.
units.negative_test: Out-of-order events, unknown fields, tenant mismatch and slow subscribers cannot corrupt state or leak private context.

units.title: Historical graph replay and plan comparison
units.scope: Provide a read-only timeline and plan-difference view over persisted events; distinguish live, paused and historical views.
acceptance_criteria: An operator can reconstruct assignments and plan changes at an earlier cursor.
Replay never invokes tools or changes canonical state.
units.negative_test: A historical event cannot be interpreted as a new live external action.

units.title: Saved visual workspace and accessible navigation
units.scope: Persist orientation, layout, filters and focus; provide search, an accessible tree, responsive panels, reduced motion and bounded graph rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Preferences survive reload and hidden branches remain searchable.
Keyboard, reduced-motion and responsive browser tests pass; large graph limits are explicit.
units.negative_test: Malformed saved preferences cannot hide the root, crash the graph or execute code.

units.title: Visual workforce production acceptance
units.scope: Verify the visual workforce against real authenticated runtime events, shared names, reviewed experience, tenant isolation and the existing alpha release controls.
acceptance_criteria: A named worker retains reviewed experience through restart, reassignment and provider change.
Every displayed state and summary reconciles to authorized runtime evidence; synthetic mode is unmistakable.
units.negative_test: Loss of Boardroom name authority or event freshness cannot silently enable names or pretend workers remain live.
